# PsySH

PsySH is a runtime developer console, interactive debugger and [REPL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Read%E2%80%93eval%E2%80%93print_loop) for PHP. Learn more at [psysh.org](http://psysh.org/) and [in the manual]().
